_about.purpose: Ground truth for retrieval evaluation. Each question has exactly one article that answers it. The metrics ask: did retrieval surface that article in the top-k?
_about.provenance: Written by reading documents/penal_code.pdf and documents/Constitution_fr.pdf directly. Every expected_article was verified to exist in the corpus and to actually contain the answer.
_about.why_this_shape: No LLM judge. Retrieval is a ranking problem and ranking has real metrics (hit-rate, recall@k, MRR, nDCG). An LLM judge would be nondeterministic, cost money on every run, and could not gate a CI job.
_about.caveat: Questions are phrased as a user would type them - often without accents, often colloquially - because that is what the retriever will actually receive. That is a deliberate stress on the french_unaccent config.
